title: 4.10 What Time Is It?
unit_outcome: Talk about your home, where things are, your morning, what you do at home, the days, the time and the months in Spanish.
goal: Ask and say the time: Es la una. Son las siete de la mañana.
grammar_function: ¿Qué hora es? Es la una / Son las + hour (de la mañana/tarde/noche).
speaking_outcome: Ask and say the time: Es la una. Son las siete de la mañana.
